keyFacts: executableWitnesses filters state=ACCOUNTED, replayState=READY, continuityBindingState=READY and zero continuity blockers, but does not require strategyValidity to be VALID/non-INCOMPLETE
requiredInputsState becomes READY when runComplete, baseUniverseCount>0, accountedCount===eligibleCount and witnessSymbols.length>0
executionState becomes EXECUTED when runComplete and witnessSymbols.length>0
deriveOutcome can therefore return PHYSICALLY_INDEPENDENT_PATH_OBSERVED and LEGITIMATE_ZERO_PICK even when every continuity-ready witness still has strategyValidity=INCOMPLETE
daily_shadow_orchestrator records continuityBindingState and strategyValidity independently, so continuity READY does not imply strategy validity

strategy_evaluator.mjs computes INVALIDATED before checking missingRequiredEvidence, so strategyValidity=INVALIDATED can coexist with missing required evidence; non-INCOMPLETE alone is not a sufficient required-inputs-ready proof.

oracleConflict.requiredT13: at least one accounted witness must have real required inputs ready and strategyValidity not INCOMPLETE
oracleConflict.currentCode: does not enforce the strategy-valid witness predicate before promoting requiredInputsState/executionState

regressionGap: Existing tests cover a VALID continuity-ready witness and INCOMPLETE witnesses whose continuity is also INCOMPLETE.
No current regression covers continuityBindingState=READY with strategyValidity=INCOMPLETE.
No current regression proves all continuity-ready witnesses INCOMPLETE cannot yield LEGITIMATE_ZERO_PICK or PHYSICALLY_INDEPENDENT_PATH_OBSERVED.
risk: Physical NC-T01 could falsely claim an independently executable System2 path or legitimate zero-pick even though no witness has complete strategy-required evidence. This would convert strategy-input incompleteness into a valid execution outcome.
requiredCorrection: Define physical executable witness as ACCOUNTED + replay READY + continuity READY + zero continuity blockers + explicit requiredEvidenceComplete=true.
requiredEvidenceComplete must be derived from assessment.missingRequiredEvidence.length===0 (or an equivalent exact contract-level proof), not inferred only from strategyValidity.
strategyValidity must not be INCOMPLETE, but INVALIDATED/WEAKENING/VALID are acceptable only when requiredEvidenceComplete=true; BUY_ELIGIBLE still retains its own VALID-only rule.
Expose requiredEvidenceComplete and/or missingRequiredEvidenceCount in per-symbol physical diagnostics so the final receipt can be independently audited.
requiredInputsState=READY and executionState=EXECUTED require at least one executable strategy witness, not merely a continuity-ready witness.
candidateGenerationExecutable must remain false when no executable strategy witness exists.
candidateUniverseProvenance must distinguish CONTINUITY_READY_WITNESS_COUNT from STRATEGY_EXECUTABLE_WITNESS_COUNT and strategy-required-evidence-complete count.
LEGITIMATE_ZERO_PICK is legal only when at least one executable strategy witness was actually evaluated and all other T11-T15 gates pass.
Add fail-closed regressions for continuity READY + strategy INCOMPLETE, INVALIDATED + missing required evidence, and mixed witness sets.
acceptanceCriteria: All continuity-ready witnesses with requiredEvidenceComplete=false => requiredInputsState=INCOMPLETE, executionState=BLOCKED_INPUTS, candidateGenerationExecutable=false, resultClassification=EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE, zeroPickDisposition=INPUT_INCOMPLETE.
An INVALIDATED witness with missingRequiredEvidence.length>0 must not count as executable merely because strategyValidity is not INCOMPLETE.
At least one continuity-ready witness with requiredEvidenceComplete=true and strategyValidity in a contract-valid non-INCOMPLETE terminal/evaluated state may proceed subject to all other gates.
T14 legitimate zero-pick cannot mask T13 strategy-required-evidence failure.
No strategy thresholds, ranking, capacity, final-selection, push, capital or order semantics are changed.
